component.name: huggingface
component.title: Hugging Face
component.description: Run Hugging Face models for tasks such as text classification, summarization, chat and speech recognition, in a Python process of Deep Java Library (DJL).
component.label: ai

autoSelect.description: Whether the zero-shot-classification task returns only the label with the highest score, as a String. If false, it returns a DJL Classifications with all the labels and their scores.

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of this component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy, in which its own options replace the values.

device.description: The device to run the model on, such as auto, cpu, cuda or mps. Most tasks give it to the Transformers pipeline as device_map, where auto spreads the model over the available devices. sentence-embeddings uses cuda for auto when it is available, else cpu, and text-to-image moves the pipeline to this device.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

maxChatHistories.description: The maximum number of chat histories, one per memory ID, that the chat task keeps in memory. When there are more, the history that was updated least recently is evicted first. Zero or a negative value keeps them all

maxHistoryMessages.description: The maximum number of messages that the chat task keeps in a chat history, besides the system prompt. The oldest messages are dropped first, and the kept messages start with a user message, so an odd value keeps one message less. 0 keeps every message. 1 and negative values are rejected, as they would keep no reply

maxTokens.description: The maximum number of new tokens that the model generates, as max_new_tokens, for the text-generation, summarization and chat tasks.

memoryIdHeader.description: The name of the header that holds the memory ID for the chat task. Each memory ID has its own chat history, so that several users can chat at the same time. A message without this header uses the memory ID default.

minLength.description: The minimum length, in tokens, of the summary that the summarization task generates.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on the Hugging Face Hub, for example distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english or Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The model must support the task.

modelLoadingTimeout.description: The time in seconds that DJL waits for the Python process to start and load the model. With 0 or a negative value, DJL uses the MODEL_LOADING_TIMEOUT environment variable, or else 240 seconds.

multiLabel.description: Whether the zero-shot-classification task scores each candidate label on its own, so that several labels can be true. If false, the scores of all the labels add up to 1.

pooling.description: Whether all requests share one Python process, which loads the model once and runs one request at a time. If false, each request starts a new Python process, which loads the model again, and stops it afterwards.

predictorBean.description: The name of a bean of type org.apache.camel.component.huggingface.tasks.TaskPredictor that runs the task instead of a built-in predictor. It is required for a task that is not built in. The producer fails to start if the registry has no such bean.

predictTimeout.description: The time in seconds that DJL waits for the Python process to answer one request. With 0 or a negative value, DJL uses the PREDICT_TIMEOUT environment variable, or else 120 seconds.

revision.description: The revision of the model on the Hugging Face Hub: a branch name, a tag name or a commit ID.

systemPrompt.description: The system message that the chat task puts first in a new chat history, for example You are a helpful assistant named Alan.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature for the text-generation, summarization and chat tasks. A higher value gives more random text. A value of 0 or less turns sampling off, so the model picks the most likely token each time.

topK.description: The number of labels with the highest scores that the text-classification task returns.

userRole.description: The role of the message that the chat task adds to the chat history from the message body. Set it to the role that the chat template of the model expects, for example human.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

authToken.label: security
authToken.description: The Hugging Face user access token, needed to download gated or private models. When the oauthProfile option is set, the token that it obtains replaces this option.

oauthProfile.label: security
oauthProfile.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token is acquired from the configured identity provider and used as authToken. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

CamelHuggingFaceOutput.description: The result of the task, which the producer sets. It is the raw JSON for text-classification, sentence-embeddings and zero-shot-classification with autoSelect=false, the PNG bytes for text-to-image, the DJL Audio for text-to-speech, and else the same text as the body.

CamelChatClearHistory.label: producer
CamelChatClearHistory.description: For the chat task, clears the stored conversation history of the current memory id before the request is built. The memory id is read from the header named by the memoryIdHeader option.

producerIn.description: Most tasks take the text as a String, and fail on bytes or a stream: the text to classify, the prompt, or the text to summarize or speak. question-answering takes a DJL QAInput, zero-shot-classification a List or array of Strings with the text first and then the labels, sentence-embeddings a String or a List or array of them, and automatic-speech-recognition a DJL Audio. chat converts the body to the text of the user message, and a null body sends the history alone. With predictorBean, the predictor bean reads the body

producerOut.description: The result as text for text-generation, question-answering (the answer), summarization, automatic-speech-recognition (the transcript) and chat (the reply). text-classification gives DJL Classifications, as zero-shot-classification does with autoSelect=false (else the best label as text); sentence-embeddings a float[][] with a vector per sentence, text-to-image the PNG image as bytes, and text-to-speech a DJL Audio. The CamelHuggingFaceOutput header has the result too, as the raw JSON for the classifications and the embeddings

task.description: The task to run, such as text-classification or chat. The name is case insensitive, and a dash equals an underscore. CUSTOM, or any other name, needs the predictorBean option, whose bean then runs the task.
